 Job Summary
 



 We are looking for a skilled Python \+ AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy intelligent software solutions powered by artificial intelligence. The ideal candidate has strong Python programming skills, experience with machine learning and generative AI technologies, and the ability to build scalable AI applications and APIs.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Design, develop, and maintain Python\-based applications and backend services.
* Build and integrate AI/ML models into production applications.
* Develop applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open\-source models.
* Create AI\-powered chatbots, virtual assistants, document processing systems, and automation tools.
* Develop REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases.
* Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
* Integrate third\-party APIs and cloud AI services.
* Optimize AI model performance, latency, and cost.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Debug, test, and deploy applications using CI/CD best practices.
* Stay current with advancements in AI, machine learning, and Python technologies.



 Required Skills
 


* Strong proficiency in Python
* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Good understanding of object\-oriented programming and software design principles.
* Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit\-learn.
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering.
* Knowledge of RAG architecture, embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, or Milvus).
* Experience using AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure OpenAI, etc.).
* Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
* Understanding of Docker and containerized deployments.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
* 2–5\+ years of experience in Python development.
* Experience deploying AI applications in production.
* Knowledge of MLOps, model monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with Kubernetes is a plus.
* Familiarity with OCR, computer vision, speech AI, or NLP is an advantage.
* Contributions to open\-source projects or AI research are a plus.



 Nice\-to\-Have Skills
 


* Agentic AI frameworks (CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph).
* MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration.
* Fine\-tuning open\-source LLMs.
* Hugging Face ecosystem.
* Data engineering tools such as Pandas, NumPy, and Apache Spark.
* Message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.



 What We Offer
 


* Competitive salary and performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI products.
* Flexible work environment.
* Professional development and certification support.
* Collaborative and innovative engineering culture.
* Career growth opportunities in AI and emerging technologies.
